decision_conditions:
The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
site_name: Old Deer Park, Royal Mid Surrey Golf Club
subdivision_of_building: No buildings within red line site boundary
description: Proposed installation of lighting columns (with optional warm white or red LEDs) and automatic vehicle barrier in access road
